reason: I'd rather buy from a brand I already trust, and I've never heard of NORTHLINE. On $17k a year I can't afford to gamble $38 on a tee I can't touch, so a brand with no reviews or customer photos doesn't get my money yet.
objection: There are no real customer reviews or photos, so I can't check if the 240gsm and the fit are true. It's online only, and I don't know how returns work, so if the tee or jeans come out thin or the fit is off, I'm stuck with it.
would_change_my_mind: A pile of honest reviews and unedited customer photos from real buyers, plus a clear free-returns policy. 15% off alone wouldn't do it.
